prompt: I'm bolting a steel bracket onto a machine frame and the bracket has a slightly oversized slot, so a normal nut keeps digging in and pulling through. I need a fastener that threads onto a stud and spreads the clamping load over a wider area of the bracket surface so I don't need a separate washer. It has to be turned with a standard open-end wrench, and it needs plenty of grip length because the stud sticks out quite far and vibration keeps loosening things. Can you design something that works for that?

judge.notes: Only the use case was described. Grade whether the design would serve that use; any geometry that works is correct.
